future_admission_requirements: Use an authorized retrieval worker and public, lawfully accessible sources only.
Never bypass authentication, paywalls, access controls, robots restrictions, or license restrictions.
Record the canonical URL, retrieval outcome, license or access terms, content digest, and source provenance for each item.
Treat links, descriptions, and normalized labels as discovery evidence until the actual item is validated.
Keep unavailable items blocked and design a self-contained alternative when retrieval or redistribution is not permitted.
Reclassify a record as an official unit only after its identity, role, sequence, and content are independently supported.
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: LINKED_NOT_RETRIEVED or DESCRIBED_NOT_LOCATED may become AVAILABLE only through a durable successful retrieval-and-validation record; prose claims are insufficient.
retrieval_policy.failure_policy: Preserve the failed retrieval outcome and reason without fabricating, summarizing, or assigning missing content.
